title: Count Worker Crashes as Job Exceptions in Laravel 13.34
content:
Laravel 13.34 counts worker crashes toward maxExceptions, notifies interruptible jobs before a timeout, adds job durations to JobProcessed, and more.

The post Count Worker Crashes as Job Exceptions in Laravel 13.34 appeared first on Laravel News.
